item.title: Christopher High volleyball star Finley Corona heads to Chico State

item.title: Santa Clara County breaks ground on Children’s Advocacy Center in Morgan Hill
item.description: The County of Santa Clara will soon begin construction of a new Children’s Advocacy Center at Valley Health Center in Morgan Hill.
